prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer. This is the ONE corrective redraw of a medieval dialogue portrait, on a 74×100 logical pixel canvas.
Image 1 is the flawed v1 portrait to substantially revise. Image 2 is the character's identity master, not a style target. Images 3–6 are the four approved chunky small-grid anatomy references.
CRITICAL CORRECTIONS: Make the actual FACE much larger and the bare NECK dramatically shorter. The facial skin from forehead to chin should occupy logical rows 17–87. Chin at row 87, and only 3–4 rows of bare neck between jaw and the narrow clothing edge. There is NO exposed upper chest. Collar occupies only rows 91–96. Head top around row 4. Preserve the ENTIRE crown, ears and rear hairstyle/headscarf with at least FOUR logical pixels of genuinely transparent space around top/left/right. The collar also ends above the canvas. No object may touch the actual image boundary. Achieve this by REDRAWING the head, hairstyle and neckline proportions, not by adding blank padding to v1.
Replace the huge bright white eye areas with SMALL, DARK, HOODED eyes: each visible eye opening only 1–2 logical pixels tall. Brown-black pupils in a dark socket; any tiny visible sclera must be a single muted midtone ochre/gray-brown pixel, DARKER than the adjacent cheek highlight. NO ivory or white eye patches, no eyeliner flourish, no sparkle. Mature eyes integrated into brow/cheek planes.
Rebuild nose, cheekbones and jaw into broad connected angular flat color masses. Use fewer and larger connected tones. Hair/headcloth are also broad masses, no thin stripe texture, no isolated bright flecks. This is an intentionally low-resolution 74×100 portrait, NOT detailed illustration shrunk afterward. At most 32 flat earthy colors, crisp square clusters, transparent background. Avoid gradients, antialiasing, dithering, noise, fine wrinkle hatching, painterly smudges, anime eyes, beautification, text, props, hands, shoulders, chest, scene, border, watermark.
IDENTITY TO RETAIN: Sujin EED-NPC-SUJIN, a WOMAN AROUND FIFTY. Broad weathered face, mature heavy lower lids, strong cheeks and squared lower face, gray-streaked brown short hair and the recognisable low-volume taupe headscarf with a rear tied knot. Calm, guarded, quietly grieving craftswoman, not a teenager or mystical elder. Slight left three-quarter view, restrained closed mouth. Show age through broad under-eye, nasolabial, cheek and jaw planes; no beautifying or fine scratched wrinkle lines. Deep FOREST-GREEN worn work collar, a single small brown apron strap edge. NO wide scoop neck or bare upper chest: clothing begins immediately beneath the short supporting neck. The complete rear scarf knot and hair need FOUR logical pixels of real transparent clearance on the right; make the scarf lower-volume rather than clipping it.
